description: This Java class 'URL' constructs and provides access to URLs for fetching weather data from the OpenWeatherMap API, using location coordinates and city name.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: A utility class for constructing weather API URLs based on location coordinates and city name.

methods.name: URL
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the URL for weather data based on current location coordinates.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Returns the constructed URL for weather data based on location.

methods.name: setCity_url
methods.description: Static method to set the URL for fetching weather data based on a specified city name.

methods.name: getCity_url
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the URL set for city-based weather data.
